items.title: Project Valhalla's First Preview: JEP 401 Redefines == for Java Objects
items.blurb: JEP 401, integrated into JDK 28, introduces value objects. These new class instances feature final fields, altered behavior for equality checks, and stricter construction and synchronization rules.
